description:
Upstream's best point, run on our framework under truncated credit.
The two searches that produced these points reached 1025.03 (ours, truncated credit) and 1063.39 (upstream), from the same opening four trials over the same space. Thirty-eight points apart is nothing to read: the sweep that recorded 1043.66 got 474.60 from the same settings under another seed, so the task's own seed spread is hundreds of points wide.
What can be read is transfer. Each framework's best point is run on the other here, both directions. A point that carries over says the two frameworks are the same machine wearing different code; a point that collapses says whatever the searches found is specific to the framework that found it, and then the ceilings agreeing was luck rather than agreement.
This is the pair that replaces a seed sweep: a seed sweep would price the noise around one point, and these two runs ask whether the points mean anything to each other at all.
name: swap-upstream-on-tbptt
